title.en: Siyata D'Shmaya — Asking for Divine Assistance

spans.text:
APPENDIX 6
SIYATA  D’SHMAYA — ASKING   
FOR DIVINE ASSISTANCE
FAQ: We say, “Do not allow the

to get the 
better of us” and, “Compel our creative powers to be 
used to serve You.” But I thought we had free will? This 
sounds like we are asking Hashem to eliminate our free 
will choices!
As we said above (in the introduction to Appendix 1) regarding

(if you skipped that, go back; otherwise, the following will make no sense), Hashem can create situations in our lives (if we are deserving) where it is easier for us to be successful in fulfilling our

mission. He can also make it harder! (See also Appendix 5 regarding Hashem creating our life situations.)By this request we are showing Hashem that we honestly do want to fulfill our mission, and are asking that He set up the reality of our day such that it will be relatively easy for us to decide to do the correct thing and that we will not be in situations where we will be tempted to make bad decisions. But in the end, any good/bad or right/wrong decision we make is completely up to our free will; see Appendix 5.
